common_rules: Types and JSON contracts are detailed in value-and-rule-contracts.md.
Required means NOT NULL; optional defaults NULL unless listed. Empty collection only means no recorded entries, never proof none exist.
UUID4 is a proposal default; legacy native auth integer/string primary keys stay through adapter/mapping until migration discussion.
All published originals/rules/snapshots/decisions are immutable except authorized content erasure with tombstones.

Framework auth entities explicitly override common UUID/created_at defaults and use native Django tables. Enum values are logical domain vocabulary; database CHECK constraints enforce each listed set.
Every FK has an explicit relationship record with access mode, delete/update action and enforcement strategy; mixed public-or-owner uses constraint triggers in addition to existence FKs.
JSON schema validates local structure; publication also requires versioned semantic validators for relational IDs, scopes, units and dependency closure.
Framework entities preserve native layouts; no auth table replacement inferred.

Private content includes medical JSON, calculation traces, indexes and copied payloads. Encryption annotations require the complete storage-at-rest contract in storage-and-constraints.md; application column encryption is not proposed. Declared SQL types remain queryable inside authorized sessions. Keys are separate from protected data/backups; live privileged access remains an explicit trust boundary.

Acquired sources and reader outputs are untrusted. Reader isolation, finite versioned resource profiles, closed payload validation and isolated untrusted-byte handling are specified in storage-and-constraints.md; reader workers receive no application or benchmark credentials.
Account is the logical design name for the retained accounts.User model implemented with Django AbstractUser; inherited auth fields are not hand-built.
UUIDModel, CreatedAtModel and MutableTimeStampedModel are abstract Django implementation bases and do not create database tables; immutable rows do not receive a misleading updated_at field.

ConversationMessageChunk is a private replaceable derivative. Current CustomerProfileRevision facts and requirements override historical-message search results, and exact Message content is loaded after ranking.

The application stores no customer claim, treatment-bill, insurer-receipt, payment-ledger, cancellation-workflow or refund-workflow model. Public policy procedures remain PolicyRule knowledge for buying comparisons.
Private low-entropy text and structured payloads use keyed commitments for deduplication. SHA-256 fields on private result storage identify encrypted bytes, not guessable plaintext.
System model routing is controlled by qualified ModelRoute records; customers do not select or persist an AI provider route.
Every newly accepted Turn commits exactly one immutable TurnRouteBinding for each interactive role before enqueue; workers and retries never re-resolve mutable operator settings.
